w:r.w:t: My name is Galen T., a grateful recovering addict, with ~13 years clean. My clean date is December 2nd, 2013. This Fellowship saved my life. With 18+ years in web engineering, within a 25-year career that began in graphic design and digital publishing, it is my honor and privilege to serve as your MANA Newsletter Subcommittee Chair.

I will continue creating the print version of Straight Hope each month, transfer that content to the MANA WordPress site and lastly, convert the print edition into a fully modern, indexable, and discoverable
(React)-based Virtual Straight Hope. I have, with the authorization of the Service Committee acquired and configured a custom web domain for the virtual edition at

I want to give a genuine and heartfelt thank you to MANA in its entirety, for not only helping me to turn my life around but also granting me multiple chances to serve this community. I look forward to continuing to serve, now in this very exciting capacity.

“We sought through prayer and meditation to improve our conscious contact with God as we understood Him, praying only for knowledge of His Will for us and the power to carry that out"

As I pray and meditate to God of my understanding, I realize how little I truly understand about life. I am just trying the best I can to navigate through the hurdles that come my way. For many years alcohol and drugs seemed like the best course for me. I thought I could heighten my celebrations and drown my sorrows. Today I believe in NA and earnestly working the 12 Steps of recovery are a much better path for me.

w:r.w:t: “Our public relations policy is based on attraction rather than promotion; we
maintain personal anonymity at the level of press, radio, and films."

Personal anonymity and avoiding sensational advertising are key points to practicing Tradition 11. The best attraction to recovery is how it works, not who I am or what I have done or not done. NA meetings can now be found all over the world, and meetings are spoken in most every language. The truth is powerful enough; any attempt to exaggerate the truth takes away from this evidence.
